Transitions Level 2 · Sort Utensils by Category

Learn

Follow the 6 Steps

1. Read the labels.

2. Pick up 1 utensil.

3. Name it and its job.

4. Place it. Handles go the same way.

5. Check for wrong slots.

6. Ask for help if you are not sure.

Transitions Level 2 · Sort Utensils by Category

Learn

Stay Safe

✋ Hold a knife by the handle.

⬇ Point the blade down.

🔪 We use blunt or plastic knives only.
